1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks across all regions with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed **v2.3.0** was the most recent release that was healthy in production (the staging-only `v2.3.1-rc` was also unhealthy and doesn't apply).
2. **Rolled back** all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) from v2.3.1 to **v2.3.0**.
3. **Verified recovery**: all regions now healthy on v2.3.0, error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0002** describing the failure and rollback (the on-call engineer was paged). The first attempt timed out, but I confirmed no incident was created and retried successfully.

Recommendation captured in the incident: v2.3.1 should not be re-deployed until the health check failures are root-caused.
